Name: Cute Crab Pots
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Cute Crab Pots

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/75180093?tab=user+files]sangsaa[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6806]Flower Crab Pot[/url] mod, I decided to use the concept from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6210]Flowery Straw Hat[/url] mod and apply it to crab pots.

Also includes [b][u]Bird Crab Pots[/u][/b] alternative Swan/Pelican reskins of the vanilla crab pots, these will require Content Patcher Animations (CP-A). By default the mod is set to [u][b]Flowery Crab Pots[/b][/u]. See config section below.

[center]Table for the dynamic decorations:
[spoiler][img]https://i.imgur.com/veoGvle.png[/img][/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u0AHuLR.gif[/img][/center][/size][size=5][b][u]Installation
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3]﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
﻿[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] (Only required for the optional AT version)
﻿- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] (optional just for the Bird Crab Pots)
[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Config
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]There are 2 config settings for this mod, run the game once to generate a config file. The default is [b][u]Flowery Crab Pots[/u][/b], this includes all the dynamically changing flowers and festival decorations.
The optional setting is [u][b]Bird Crab Pots[/b][/u], this includes the animated Swan and Pelican crab pots. The Swan will replace the vanilla crab pot except on the beach where it will be an animated Pelican.

[/size][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Let me know what you think or leave some suggestions if you got any ideas.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mKu0Vt4.gif[/img][/center][/size]
